contribution_types.label: UNKNOWN: no AAAI-25 contribution taxonomy recovered
contribution_types.scope: AAAI-25 contribution categories were published in the main-technical-track CFP, whose URL is aliased to the AAAI-26 page; that aliased text is not a valid AAAI-25 source, so the taxonomy stays unknown.
contribution_types.quote: Papers must be formatted in AAAI two-column, camera-ready style; see the AAAI-25 author kit for details.

review_criteria.name: Citation and Comparison
review_criteria.official_explanation: Papers are expected to cite and compare against the most relevant refereed publications.
review_criteria.quote: Papers are expected to cite those refereed publications most relevant to their content, but authors are excused for not knowing about all non-refereed work

review_criteria.name: Reproducibility
review_criteria.official_explanation: Reviewers assess the degree to which reported results are reproducible, and this is weighed in decisions.
review_criteria.quote: Reviewers will be asked to assess the degree to which the results reported in a paper are reproducible, and this assessment will be weighed when making final decisions about each paper.

review_criteria.name: Ethics and Professional Conduct
review_criteria.official_explanation: Authors and reviewers must honour the AAAI Publications Ethics and Malpractice Statement.
review_criteria.quote: All AAAI authors and reviewers are required to honor the AAAI Publications Ethics and Malpractice Statement

review_criteria.name: Blind-Review Compliance
review_criteria.official_explanation: AAAI-25 reviews are double blind; identity-revealing information may lead to summary rejection.
review_criteria.quote: AAAI-25 reviews are double blind (i.e., neither reviewers nor authors should be able to identify each other).

mandatory_policy.statement: At least one author must present the paper in person and register at the in-person rate.
mandatory_policy.quote: At least one author is required to present that paper in person and therefore register for the conference at the in-person rate.

mandatory_policy.statement: All presentations must be in person; there is no remote presentation option.
mandatory_policy.quote: All presentations must be done in-person. There will be no remote presentation option.

mandatory_policy.statement: Technical content is limited to seven pages, with references on additional pages.
mandatory_policy.quote: Submissions may consist of up to 7 pages of technical content plus additional pages solely for references; acknowledgements should be omitted from papers submitted for review.

mandatory_policy.statement: Submissions are anonymous and must follow the double-blind instructions.
mandatory_policy.quote: AAAI submissions are anonymous and must conform to the instructions (detailed below) for double-blind review.

mandatory_policy.statement: LLM-generated text is prohibited unless it is part of the paper’s experimental analysis; LLMs cannot be authors or citable sources.
mandatory_policy.quote: Papers that include text generated from a large-scale language model (LLM) such as ChatGPT are prohibited unless the produced text is presented as a part of the paper
mandatory_policy.conditions: Permitted when the generated text is presented as part of the experimental analysis.

recommended_practice.statement: Authors are encouraged to include detailed reproducibility information in the technical appendix.
recommended_practice.quote: Information related to reproducing experimental results described in the submission may be included in the main paper or the Code and Data Appendix, as appropriate.

recommended_practice.statement: Authors are encouraged, especially at camera-ready, to address contemporaneous work.
recommended_practice.quote: authors are not obliged to address such papers (though, especially for the camera ready versions of accepted papers, authors are encouraged to do so)

recommended_practice.statement: Authors may express interest in giving a public demonstration of their system.
recommended_practice.quote: authors will be able to express interest in giving a public demo of systems described in the paper.

compliance_checks.requirement: Technical content is at most seven pages, plus references-only pages.
No author or affiliation information in the submission.
Reproducibility checklist answers appear after the references.
No author exceeds the 10-submission technical-track cap.
At least one author registers at the in-person rate and presents.
No archival submission under parallel review elsewhere.

changes_from_prior_year.change: Material changes relative to AAAI-24 could not be established.

The AAAI-25 main-technical-track CFP is not recoverable: the -call URL serves the AAAI-26 page and the genuine main-technical-track page is logistics-only, so AAAI-25 evaluation-rubric changes cannot be confirmed.
